dataset: NIST XCOM: Photon Cross Sections Database (NIST Standard Reference Database 8)
authors: M.J. Berger, J.H. Hubbell, S.M. Seltzer, J. Chang, J.S. Coursey, R. Sukumar, D.S. Zucker, K. Olsen
conversion: HDF5 conversion from nist-calculators 0.0.5 (MIT licence), converted to JSON by backend/scripts/build_xcom_data.py
notes: Cross sections in barn/atom. Energies in MeV.
At absorption edges the grid contains two points separated by ~1e-7 MeV carrying the photoelectric cross section below and above the edge.
atomic_weight_xcom is the atomic-weight table used by the XCOM program to convert barn/atom to cm2/g.
incomplete_edges lists edges whose upper-side photoelectric value is missing from the source conversion; the engine refuses to interpolate there.
